# Copilot instructions

The contributor guide is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root — the
stack, the commands, the conventions, the product decisions a PR is judged
against, and a section addressed to coding agents specifically. Read it before
changing anything here.

[REVIEW.md](../REVIEW.md) is what gets a pull request sent back, and
[.agents/skills/](../.agents/README.md) holds the procedures for jobs with a
right order (worker tasks, API routes, tests, verification, edge sweeps).

This file exists only because Copilot reads `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
Nothing is duplicated into it — two copies of the same rules drift, and then
nobody knows which one is the contract.
